model_annotation: This plot illustrates the loss values over iterations for several language models. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 140000, with tick labels spaced approximately 20000 units apart. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and spans a range from approximately 2.4 to 3.4, with a linear scale and tick labels spaced approximately 0.2 units apart. A blue line represents the VanillaLLM, which starts at a loss value near 3.4 and steadily decreases to approximately 2.6 by the end of the x-axis. A turquoise line represents the StrLmLM (n=64), beginning at a loss value of approximately 3.3 and decreasing to roughly 2.7. An orange line displays the SepLLM (n=64), commencing at a loss of approximately 3.2 and decreasing to around 2.6. A dark green line represents SepLLM (n=64, H), which starts at roughly 3.1 and decreases to approximately 2.5. A red line signifies SepLLM (n=64, H/T), beginning at approximately 3.0 and decreasing to around 2.7. Finally, a black line depicts SepLLM (n=128), which starts at roughly 3.0 and decreases to approximately 2.8.
